edges.reason: _newImplementation is stored into the implementation state variable.
_operator is stored into the operator state variable.
_validatorFactory is stored into the validatorFactory state variable.
The modifier compares msg.sender against the stored validatorFactory address.
validatorFactory state variable is the reference value in the access control require.
The isValidatorFactory modifier gates execution of setValidatorImplementation.
The isValidatorFactory modifier gates execution of setOperator.
_newValidatorImplementation overwrites the implementation state variable.
_newOperator overwrites the operator state variable.
_implementation returns the implementation state variable.
_fallback calls _implementation to resolve the delegate target.
_fallback delegates control to _delegate, which performs an external delegatecall.
The fallback entry point invokes _fallback.
The receive entry point invokes _fallback.
_fallback executes the _beforeFallback hook.
_delegate executes the delegatecall unsafe operation on the resolved implementation.
The delegatecall forwards execution to the implementation, which can call back into the proxy fallback.

_transferOwnership reads the current owner into the oldOwner local variable.
